name: hovduc/ocr-invoice
description: An intelligent OCR system for automated invoice data extraction from Vietnamese retail receipts. The project combines traditional deep learning pipelines (PaddleOCR, DB text detection, VGG-Transformer recognition, LayoutXLM for key information extraction) with a modern Gemini-Flash VLM alternative for simpler, faster, and more accurate extraction.
